title: 별점 2.3
suno_analysis_sp: K-pop ballad featuring a female vocalist. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing arpeggiated patterns. A subtle bass guitar enters during the first verse, providing melodic counterpoint. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G Major. The female vocals are delivered in a soft, breathy, and intimate style with minimal processing, emphasizing natural vibrato and clear diction. The production is sparse and organic, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the acoustic guitar's resonance.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[soft female vocals]
마지막 박스테이프를 봉하려다
박스 제일 밑에 뭔가 걸렸어 [bass guitar enters]
꺼내 보니 스무 살의 내 얼굴
낯선 것도 아닌데 익숙한 것도 아닌
오래된 앨범지 냄새가 번졌지
이삿짐 다 싸놓은 텅 빈 방
마루에 주저앉아 한참을 보았거든
